This is the second time I've posted about my dog, a two-year-old Maltipoo, and because they were too lazy to remove the hair, they shaved him completely, despite my recommendation to only trim the tips!
I'm adding before and after photos! I don't find it professional, I can share my experience with others. Luckily, hair grows quickly, but trust doesn't! That's a dead giveaway, before and after photos.
We took our poodle puppy to them and they did an excellent job. Even though it was a very scary experience for our little pup, they treated him very well, and I'd like to thank them again.
Excellent grooming, you are the best.

I have a 2-year-old wire-haired dachshund, Mario. He needed to be stripped.
Perfect job, and—very important to me—when I arrived to pick him up, Mario was not only beautiful, but he wasn't tied up, free to roam, and visibly happy.
A truly perfect experience! I'll be back in October for the next stripping, and this time, I know I'll be leaving my puppy in excellent hands. Thank you! ☺️

Best

Veronica and her grooming studio are a prime example of excellence in Milan. Other well-known groomers [and I've known them all for 20 years] have a commercial approach and offer "off-the-shelf" cuts, meaning they're all the same for every breed. Veronica, on the other hand, dedicates herself with care and expertise to identifying the right cut for each breed. In addition to the impeccable cleanliness and hygiene of her beautiful premises, the use of ozonated water and top-quality products, and offering personalized services that are performed seriously (and not just paid for like elsewhere), our dogs are welcomed and treated with care, NOT chained or caged (which is commonplace), and they are given all the time and attention they need to avoid stress or trauma. You can sense great passion and affection for animals.

I've recommended Veronica and her studio to at least 20 owners, and they're all satisfied and have abandoned their previous groomers, who have slipped into the cycle of pure business...one after another.

This makes VIP Grooming a point of reference and pride in Milan, distinguished by hygiene, care, skill, passion, and sincere affection for our animals, and...great education and kindness.
Thank you, Veronica, for what you always do for my young, very blond Bichon Havanese, whose haircut attracts attention and praise everywhere.
Great experience. Attentive, positive, punctual service with a right price. Thank you.

We stumbled upon it by chance while looking for a place in Milan that could care for my 12-year-old Maltese... in short, with special attention. I was delighted with the service and the care they give Mia. It's now our place. Mia is very calm, and this tells me she's treated very well and they are great!

Incredibly satisfied. I'm the new father of a little Schnauzer with a very woolly coat. VIP Grooming not only made Caterina feel like a princess but also taught me how to properly care for my puppy. The center is welcoming, the staff is knowledgeable, and the owner loves her job and our faithful furry friends. A wide range of top-quality products are available, which are used in the treatments. We know how difficult it is to trust someone to care for our pet; VIP Grooming makes you feel calm and reassured.
After the treatment, Caterina is beautiful, healthy, and relaxed. I couldn't be happier to know that a place like VIP Grooming exists.
Our Skipper is gorgeous after being pampered by Very Important Pet. Highly recommended, professional and clean!
Wonderful grooming salon!
Veronica is very friendly and attentive, and they did a great job grooming my dog. I'm very satisfied. thank you very much, we will come again🌹❤️ …
Finally a team that knows how to take care of the dog and make it feel good, with excellent results

I had a wonderful experience at this grooming salon The staff were friendly, professional, and truly caring with my pet. They paid great attention to detail, and the grooming was done perfectly. My baby came back looking clean, happy, and well-taken care of the salon is also very clean and welcoming. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for quality grooming services
Excellent! Attentive, precise, and incredibly kind to both humans and animals. Exceptional value for money. Highly recommended. I almost never leave reviews, but they truly deserve it.
Brought my little furry friend for the first time... found a very nice environment... professional and relaxing... final result: washed dog... clipped... smelling good and happy... recommended 🫡 …
Impeccable service highly recommendations

To be honest, I just wanted to wash my dog, but afterward I asked her to trim his fur a little. When I went to pick him up an hour and a half later, I was shocked. It was the first time in three years that someone had done it this beautifully. No one has ever done a doggie haircut in the afternoon, but she's really great. Thank you so much, dear.
We in love of this grooming, from our first grooming till the last one every time was perfect. Highly recommend

The TOP! Hospitality, professionalism, cleanliness, organization, and perfect grooming. Veronica's kindness and attention to the customer, but especially to our furry friends, is exemplary. My poodle Giotto came out today beautiful and happy. Congratulations to all the staff 👏 …
Very satisfied with the results on SIRIUS. Perfect cut. Thank you.

A truly exceptional pet shop! The quality of the products is excellent, and you can immediately sense the professionalism, care, and attention given to customers and their pets.
I even make a short drive to get there, but it's absolutely worth it: every minute is well spent. My Pomeranian is treated with incredible affection and adores her owner, a very sweet, helpful, and truly adorable person.
I once asked for just a small trim to my Pomeranian's fur, and since then, her hair has become thicker and more beautiful. Perfect!!
Highly recommended, I'll sign up without hesitation! 🐶✨
First experience today with Coco, my Samoyed. Very professional, precise, excellent results. Highly recommended.
I really enjoyed my time with Rocco, who was very kind and patient, and who has become incredibly handsome. Thank you Veronica and my colleague. See you soon. Bianca Morandi

Fantastic experience! Veronica and her staff are amazing and so sweet. My dog ​​(Ettore) always goes home happy ❤️. Impeccable cut and bath. I recommend everyone bring their dog here for a grooming, bath, or spa experience just like your pooches!
So friendly and really good experience 😊 …
Thank you for your professionalism and love for animals!

This is the first time I've brought my puppy to this real spa for our four-legged friends. The welcome was top-notch, the staff were very kind, and we were very happy, even our little Buddy was very happy. Thanks to Veronica for her professionalism, skill, and love for animals! Thank you and see you soon.

Very disappointed, I sent my dog ​​for a grooming and spa appointment. After an hour without any notification, I went there to collect it, and there was no grooming done at all.

The appointment had been reserved in Keyla's name for Kate, her dog. It was scheduled for August 12th, but there was an email saying there would be no activities that week. We rescheduled for August 7th. We never received a confirmation email or text; Keila had to go to the facility to confirm the appointment. Once we picked her up, again without a confirmation text, we picked Kate up without grooming, and gave her a final spray of perfume before leaving. I don't know if they gave her a bath (spa), but they certainly didn't groom her. We paid 50 euros for everything and, once again, NO GROOMING.

Veronica is a real guarantee.
Super professional, helpful, and incredibly sweet with puppies.
I couldn't have chosen a better groomer for my poodle Chloe.
I highly recommend Very Important Pet

Simply fantastic, it's the first time they've done Winnie exactly how I wanted it. The environment is neat, beautiful, and clean. Veronica is fantastic, sweet and empathetic, kind, and ready to make our special friends feel at ease—a true rarity. The spa, too, is a real gem (I'm waiting for the video 😊). We've finally found our ideal groomer. Until next time, in the meantime, I'm spreading the word... 😉

😁 I'm truly happy and satisfied with the service and how they left my little Teddy 🐾. I can say we've found our permanent and reliable place to cuddle my little one every month 🐾.
I absolutely recommend 💯. Thank you ☺️ …

Excellent service for my Dalmatian, Skipper. The girl at the front desk was very helpful and smiling (not a given these days). Skipper left smelling good, clean, and above all calm and happy. We'll definitely be back!

A true professional, sweet, loving, and above all passionate about her work.
My Cey Cey (a poodle, and we know how important grooming is for them!) shines in all his beauty thanks to her.
I highly recommend her to everyone.
